dct_description_sm: Representatives from the three northern territories have created a Pan-Territorial Partnership. The work activities in this project were the culmination of careful planning on activities to address Pan-Territorial identified needs. The project included creating user friendly fact-sheets and hosting a Permafrost Workshop. Both activities catalyzed the work of the three northern territories in their collaborative efforts on the actions identified in the Pan-Territorial Adaptation Strategy (PTAS).
